title: Leaning on experience with Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes, Giants leaders aren't just telling Jaxson Dart to run more carefully. They're showing him

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Leaning on experience with Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes, Giants leaders aren't just telling Jaxson Dart to run more carefully. They're showing him
sources.description: "It's like, 'Dude, it's the third preseason game against the Patriots … what are you doing?'" Giants GM Joe Schoen said. "You'd rather say 'whoa, whoa' than 'giddy up' with these guys."
